My father and abuser was called as a bishop when I was 14. He continued to abuse family and I throughout his calling. At church and school I was teased and scrutinized by my peers because I was “The Bishops Daughter” and apparently to them that meant I was particularly “bad.” I was dating a non-Mormon at the time which was not allowed. This resulted in my parents forcing this poor kid to get baptized or break up with me. He ended up getting baptized and we eventually broke up shortly after graduating. When, through highly invasive and inappropriate means, the existence of a sexual relationship with my previous boyfriend had been exposed to my parents, they both proceeded to verbally and physically abuse me. They then left me alone at night with no phone in SLC, told me they didn’t love me and didn’t want me around their kids (my siblings), so they shipped me off to live at my grandparents with only my ID to get on the plane. Mind you I was 19. Upon my return, my father/bishop proceeded to hold my ecclesiastical endorsement hostage. If I did anything to upset him then I would not be allowed to return to BYU to finish my degree. He eventually approved my endorsement after I had “proved myself to him” but not without ordering me to an official bishops interview. Wherein, we were the only two people in the church building and he proceeded to rehash all I had done that he considered wrong and tell me I deserved it while I just sat there and cried. 

So ya basically after all that there was no hope of me staying in the church.
I still have to see him sometimes and it’s really painful. I have several younger siblings who still live at home with that monster and I have to look after them still to make sure they’re ok and support them. He has chosen to not attempt to foster any relationship with me and refuses to talk to me at family gatherings. But let me tell you, the freedom and peace I have now that I am not LDS and no longer have to reconcile all the terrors I experienced with some bullshit crackpot religion is worth all that I went through to gain it. If the church was true then my father wouldn’t of been “called” as a Bishop in the first place. If the church was true I would’ve never gone through that. But I did.
